title: Oklahoma 12, Oklahoma State 7: Nov. 25, 2000 Bedlam Scare
question: What was the score of Oklahoma vs. Oklahoma State on November 25, 2000?
answer: No. 1 Oklahoma beat Oklahoma State 12-7 in Stillwater on November 25, 2000. The win made the Sooners 11-0 and completed their first perfect regular season since 1987.
summary: On Nov. 25, 2000, No. 1 Oklahoma survived a Bedlam scare in Stillwater, beating Oklahoma State 12-7 to finish 11-0, its first perfect regular season since 1987.
body: On Saturday, November 25, 2000, top-ranked Oklahoma traveled to Stillwater for the regular-season finale against Oklahoma State. The Sooners were 10-0 and already heading to the Big 12 Championship Game, where Kansas State awaited the next week.

Oklahoma started the way a No. 1 team should. Josh Heupel threw a 3-yard touchdown pass to Curtis Fagan to cap a 99-yard opening drive. Later in the first half, a J.T. Thatcher interception and 35-yard return set up a field goal, and a safety pushed the lead to 12-0.

The afternoon got tense from there. Heupel had a season-low 154 passing yards and threw two interceptions, and late in the third quarter Oklahoma State freshman Tatum Bell ripped off a 60-yard touchdown run to make it 12-7.

The Cowboys later reached the Oklahoma 12 on fourth-and-goal, but cornerback Derrick Strait broke up the pass in the end zone. Oklahoma held on, finished the regular season 11-0 (8-0 in the Big 12), and recorded its first unbeaten regular season since 1987.
The Sooners went on to beat Kansas State for the Big 12 title and finished the season as national champions, which makes this narrow escape an easy one to forget.
